landing.subtitle: Modern testing platform designed for students and teachers. Deeply analyze results using artificial intelligence.

landing.teacher_desc: Create tests with AI and manage groups.
landing.faq_q1: How do I use the platform?
landing.faq_a1: The system is divided into 3 main portals: Student, Teacher, and Admin. Each portal is accessed with appropriate login credentials.
landing.faq_q2: How does AI test creation work?
landing.faq_a2: Teachers can automatically generate questions using Gemini AI in the test creation section. Just enter the subject and number of questions.
landing.faq_a3: As soon as a student completes the test, it is automatically graded and the results summary is immediately displayed on the screen.
